svg.title: absentia scene: an archive and a claim converge into one attestation
svg.desc: Illustrative still: an archive of pages and chunks and a claim with deterministic variants both feed an N by M matrix that scores every pair with FTS5 trigram, a LIKE fallback and local sentence vectors, combined with max and no sampling. The matrix produces one attestation carrying corpus, matrix, bound, variants and verdict, with core_sha256; verify rebuilds in a temporary directory and returns AGREES.
